facts.text: Frankford was likely named after a Philadelphia neighborhood by a visitor who came to help at the township's rural school.
Frankford Township was incorporated in 1798 as one of the first 104 townships established by the New Jersey Legislature.
The borough of Branchville is completely surrounded by Frankford Township, making it one of the state's rare doughnut towns.
Culver's Lake and Lake Owassa are two natural lakes that form the northern border of Frankford.
Frankford's Skylands Park has hosted several professional baseball teams, including the New Jersey Cardinals and the Sussex County Miners.
The landscape of Frankford was shaped 450 million years ago when a chain of volcanic islands collided with proto North America.
